The logs end with successful exit markers and correspond to the current diagnostic/source state described by the durable index. A separate current acceptance defect remains below.

blocking_findings.finding: The required light-theme visual QA was not actually captured. The harness sets data-theme before openPdf, but openPdf navigates/reloads the document and clears that DOM-only attribute. Direct hashes confirm every claimed light screenshot is byte-identical to its dark counterpart, including both 1380 captures and all 900 captures. The evidence therefore supplies two copies of the dark state, not dark-and-light coverage, so task .6's eight-way visual acceptance is unmet despite the browser gate exiting successfully.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Apply and verify the requested theme after openPdf navigation (or persist it through the application's supported theme mechanism), wait until computed theme colors reflect the requested state, assert dark and light computed values differ, then regenerate the full dark/light × 1380/900 × rail/overview screenshot matrix and durable browser evidence.

blocking_findings.finding: The added diagnostics introduce a privacy regression by serializing durable per-file hashes and metadata for real user configuration, including credential-bearing config file, together with its absolute home path, size, mode, and mtime. A credential hash is a persistent verifier/fingerprint derived from secret contents; placing it in a review artifact is unnecessary for proving unchanged state and contradicts the artifact's secret-hygiene claim.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Keep the before/after isolation assertion, counts, byte totals, and non-sensitive database/stat evidence, but redact credential-bearing paths and content-derived hashes from durable output. Record a safe equality result for sensitive files without emitting their names, absolute locations, hashes, sizes, or timestamps; regenerate gate-package.log and update the receipt/index privacy claims.

non_blocking_observations: P-1 through P-6 remain asserted without threshold/oracle weakening: P-3 records 6 starts against the <=60 threshold with zero orphans/doubles/dropped and finalWindowRendered=3; P-4a records 20 samples with the 19th sorted value 79.3 ms against 500 ms; P-4b records two overlap runs and ordered cancellation; P-6 records destroy and zero late starts.

The progressive artifact records an honest initial production 200 with true Content-Length and Accept-Ranges, byte-ranged later 206 control, simultaneous rendered and pending pages, a held later range, no state card, and the expected Letter aspect ratio.
